name: Badurn
text: Badurn is a king in the old story of Ireland. One day his wife comes to a well and sees two fairy women there. The pair are joined one to the other by a chain. When they spy her they sink into the water, and she follows them into the fairy mound.

attributes.attribute: a king in the old Irish story
his wife followed the two women into the mound
